name: empty
description: A zero-state surface for lists, dashboards, and search results with no content. Explains why the slot is empty + provides a call-to-action.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon (typically an <svg>) rendered in a circular muted container above the title.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading copy. Becomes the region's accessible name via aria-labelledby.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting copy that explains why the slot is empty + what to do next.

props.name: action
props.description: Call-to-action — typically a <Button> that creates the missing record.

props.name: titleAs
props.description: Heading level for the title. Pick to match surrounding heading hierarchy.

variants.name: size
variants.description: Vertical density of the empty-state surface.

values.description: Compact — fits inside a card / panel.
values.useWhen: the empty surface is one of several stacked pieces of content; full-bleed would dominate

values.description: Standard — for table / list / dashboard widget empty states.
values.useWhen: default everywhere; the only size you need on most surfaces

values.description: Large — for full-page empty states (no items at all yet).
values.useWhen: the empty surface owns the entire page — onboarding, first-run, no records yet

slots.name: icon
slots.description: Icon rendered in the circular muted container above the title.

examples.title: List zero-state
examples.description: Inbox with no messages — icon + title + description + compose button
examples.code:
<Empty
  icon={<InboxIcon />}
  title="No messages yet"
  description="When someone sends a message, it shows up here."
  action={<Button>Compose</Button>}
/>

examples.title: Search zero-state
examples.description: Search returned zero results — show the query + suggest a reset
examples.code:
<Empty
  icon={<SearchIcon />}
  title="No results found"
  description={`No items match "${query}". Try a different search.`}
  action={<Button variant="secondary" onClick={onReset}>Clear search</Button>}
  size="sm"
/>

examples.title: Onboarding
examples.code:
<Empty
  icon={<SparklesIcon />}
  title="Welcome to your dashboard"
  description="Create your first project to get started."
  action={<Button size="lg">Create project</Button>}
  size="lg"
  titleAs="h1"
/>

ai.whenToUse: Use for lists, search results, or dashboards where the request returned successfully but there's nothing to show. Explain why and what to do — the title names the absence, the description sets context, the action gives a way out.
ai.whenNotToUse: Don't use while data is still loading (use Loading). Don't use when something failed (use ErrorState). Don't use for inline form-field 'no options' messages (use Combobox's empty slot or Form's helper text).
commonMistakes: Using Empty without an action — leaves the user stuck
Long descriptions — keep to one sentence; this is a state surface, not documentation
Forgetting titleAs when the page already has an h2 above (heading hierarchy break)

antiPatterns.mistake: Using Empty while data is still being fetched
antiPatterns.why: Empty announces 'no items exist'; Loading announces 'fetching items.' Showing Empty during the fetch flashes a misleading 'no results' state then snaps to real data on resolution.

antiPatterns.mistake: Using Empty to display a fetch failure
antiPatterns.why: ErrorState carries role='alert' so screen readers announce the failure on first render, AND it ships a retry affordance. Empty is silent on retry semantics.

antiPatterns.mistake: Using Empty as an inline 'no matching options' notice inside a Combobox or Select
antiPatterns.why: Combobox + Command already render a sub-AA-conformant empty state inside the listbox. Using Empty there leaks the page-level zero-state language into a focused interaction.

ai.accessibilityNotes: Wrapped in a region landmark labeled by the title (aria-labelledby + auto-generated id). Icon is decorative (aria-hidden). Pair the action with a Button that has a visible label.
